items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: But I spent the next 17 years with him, and recorded about five or six albums with him.

ctx.x: I love that: “Let’s do it.” Just going out on stage, had no rehearsal.
No rehearsal or anything. But I spent the next 17 years with him, and recorded about five or six albums with him.
He’s got such a unique — what’s he like as a person?
